SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Sophie Grigson: Slice Of Italy
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E8 500 Miles Sophie discovers the culinary delights of the Puglian coastline. She learns all about the sea urchin and how it's used with spaghetti. She also makes a delicious pasta sauce with the leftovers.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Kriol Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E10 Ali & Mitch Torres: Barni (Goanna) Caesar Salad & PAN Fried Damper Ali and Mitch take the bush goanna and give it a dressing up in this recipe of the traditional Caesar Salad, replacing the chicken and eggs with chunky pieces of Barni and served with damper.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook And The Chef
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E9 Pizzas Not many of us are lucky enough to have a wood oven in the back yard. But all is not lost. If you want to make brilliant home cooked pizzas, all you need is a conventional oven.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E23 Episode 23 In the heart of the beautiful McLaren Vale, Laura is joined by her chef husband, Max, to whip up a simple but awesome Italian dish, Spaghetti Aglio Olio E Pepperoncino.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E23 Truffle Eggs With Chips And Chives Living in Tuscany allows for the enjoyment of a long truffle season, Rachael shows how to use local truffles to add amazing flavour to a fun and decadent dish of scrambled eggs and potato chips.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Taste Of Australia With Hayden Quinn
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E5 More North West Tasmania Still in Tasmania's north west, Hayden hunts down the ultimate ingredients for his dream dessert-cooked on a BBQ. From windswept shores to artisan kitchens, this is Tasmania at its most delicious.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Be My Guest With Ina Garten
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S6 E1 Eric Ripert The incredible chef and world class restaurateur behind the three Michelin star Le Bernardin restaurant in New York, Eric Ripert, is cooking at the barn and sharing life-changing stories.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E18 Episode 18 Laura is joined by Sweet Greek's Kathy Tsaples to make amygdalota, Greek almond-based cookies; Asian Inspirations' chef Kinsan makes S&B curry noodles; Laura makes her cheat's ramen.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Taste Of Australia In Vietnam
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Hanoi In Hanoi, Luke learns about the work of pioneering social enterprise, KOTO, and enjoys some of his favourite street food, including the city's signature dish of Cha Ca.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E80 Powered Powders Adam is joined by cook Lilly Wright and comedian Sashi Perera to unleash the power of spice powders.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Jamie At Home
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E12 Rhubarb Rhubarb is finally having a resurgence! This is good news for the UK as historically they grow some of the best rhubarb in the world.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lidia's Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E19 Baking Bread Lidia constantly cherishes the memory of baking bread with her Grandma Rosa. She makes onion tomato focaccia then talks about Taralli. She cooks pizza rolls with two unique Italian fillings.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Cheese Slices
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E3 Roquefort With a fascinating history that dates back to Roman times, the importance of Roquefort cheese cannot be underestimated. Will visits a typical dairy to look at a unique breed of milking ewes.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: What Chefs Want
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E5 The Art And Storytelling Of Food Enter the mesmerizing world of food art, where masterpieces are created with equal parts skill and creativity. Chef Janice Wong takes Sally on a chocolate-making journey that culinary art.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Dolce Vita Riviera
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E4 Dolceacqua Set between mountains and river, Dolceacqua reveals an unexpected wealth of traditions, character and heritage.

SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E9 Nuts And Pulses Sophie visits an almond farmer to discover how they are harvested and shelled. A local baker demonstrates how she makes the almond and cherry jam sweet treats that are served all over town.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Kriol Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E1 Patty Mamid: Creamy Chilli Squid & Soybean Seafood Soup Patty Mamid shows us how to prepare creamy chilli squid and soybean seafood soup. Drawing on her multicultural heritage, Patty cooks up two dishes of her own making.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook And The Chef
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E10 Easter In Cooking It's Easter and Simon surprises Maggie with a chilli Easter Egg whipped up at work under the expert eyes of his pastry chefs. Maggie's no fan of chilli but Simon's determined to win her over.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E24 Episode 24 Luke Hines shows Laura his 5-ingredient Garlicky Hash Browns in the Prahran Market.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E24 Roast Sausage And Celery Root Flan Rachael and her sister Maria are teaming up to demonstrate how to make a rustic meal of roasted pork and chicken sausages tossed with vegetables and grapes.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Taste Of Australia With Hayden Quinn Bbq
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Manly Beach After a morning surf, Hayden demonstrates the best ways to BBQ over coals, and showcases dishes featuring salmon fillet, chicken thigh, and beef rump steak.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Be My Guest With Ina Garten
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S6 E2 Julia Louis-Dreyfus The incredible 11 time Emmy award-winning actor, comedian, writer and producer Julia Louis Dreyfus is joining Ina at the barn.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E19 Episode 19 Laura is in a French mood and makes crepes to share with the market workers. Catherine Velisha makes a late-night burger into a healthy meal with a burger that she calls the Naked Hawaiian.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Taste Of Australia In Vietnam
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 Ho Chi Minh City And Dalat Travelling to mountainous Da Lat and bustling Ho Chi Minh City, Luke enthuses about the street food, learns about a ground-breaking approach to farming and meets with artistic Australians.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield

wdrb.us.title: Young Sheldon
wdrb.us.description: For young Sheldon Cooper, it isn't easy growing up in East Texas. Being a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are king. And while the vulnerable, gifted and somewhat naive Sheldon deals with the world, his very normal family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George, is struggling to find his way as a high school football coach and as father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son. For 12 years on "The Big Bang Theory," audiences came to know the iconic, eccentric and extraordinary Sheldon Cooper. In "Young Sheldon," audiences get a chance to meet him in childhood, as he embarks on his innocent, awkward and hopeful journey toward the man he will become. Jim Parsons, who plays the adult version of Sheldon on "The Big Bang Theory," narrates. (Sitcom) - 2017-09-25

retrotv.us.description: The OCB asks Vinnie to intervene in his mother's burgeoning romance with a crime boss (George Petrie). (Drama)

fxm.us.title: Race With the Devil
fxm.us.description: Roger (Peter Fonda), his friend Frank (Warren Oates), and their wives (Lara Parker, Loretta Swit) are heading from San Antonio to the wilderness of rural Texas for some off-road motocross. What they find instead is a Satanic cult sacrifice, and they are unfortunate enough to be caught observing the ritual. Naturally, this doesn't sit too well with the cult members. Now Roger and Frank are on the run from what is apparently a very sizable Texan Satanist community. (Horror) - 1975

fxm.us.title: Wizards
fxm.us.description: After the death of his mother, the evil mutant wizard Blackwolf (Steve Gravers) discovers some long-lost military technologies. Full of ego and ambition, Blackwolf claims his mother's throne, assembles an army and sets out to brainwash and conquer Earth. Meanwhile, Blackwolf's gentle twin brother, the bearded and sage Avatar (Bob Holt), calls upon his own magical abilities to foil Blackwolf's plans for world domination -- even if it means destroying his own flesh and blood. (Animated, Fantasy) - 1977

fxm.us.title: The Fly
fxm.us.description: When scientist Andre Delambre (Al Hedison) tests his matter transporter on himself, an errant housefly makes its way into the transportation chamber, and things go horribly wrong. As a result, Delambre's head and arm are now that of the insect. Slowly losing himself to the fly, Delambre turns to his wife, Helene (Patricia Owens), for help. But when tragedy strikes, Delambre's brother (Vincent Price) and Inspector Charas (Herbert Marshall) are forced to pick up the investigation. (Horror, Science fiction) - 1958

fxm.us.title: The Curse of the Fly
fxm.us.description: Scantily clad Patricia Stanley (Carole Gray) breaks out of a mental hospital and is picked up by passing motorist Martin Delambre (George Baker). The two do not reveal much about themselves to each other, but nevertheless decide to get married. At the Delambre family mansion, Patricia meets Martin's father, Henri (Brian Donlevy), an eccentric scientist. Snooping about the grounds, she discovers evidence of the family's strange experiments in teleportation and the grisly results thereof. (Horror, Science fiction, Mystery, Drama) - 1965

fxm.us.title: Witchcraft
fxm.us.description: For generations, the Whitlocks and the Laniers have been feuding, including when Vanessa Whitlock (Yvette Rees), accused of being a witch, was buried alive centuries ago. Now Bill Lanier (Jack Hedley) wants to dig up a burial ground for development purposes, and Morgan Whitlock (Lon Chaney Jr.) tries to stop him. Soon, unexplainable accidents start to happen to members of the Lanier family, throwing suspicion on Morgan. The real truth Bill discovers is much more sinister than he expected. (Horror) - 1964

fxm.us.title: The Horror of It All
fxm.us.description: Yankee salesman Jack (Pat Boone) wants to marry Cynthia Marley (Erica Rogers), and they travel to her family's English estate to break the good news. Cynthia warns that the family is a bit odd, which proves to be an understatement. One relative is an ex-thespian who still believes he's in a play, another behaves like a vampire and a third is imprisoned in the cellar due to his violent tendencies. But things get really sinister when the Marleys start succumbing to violent fates, one by one. (Horror) - 1964

fxm.us.title: Young Frankenstein
fxm.us.description: Respected medical lecturer Dr. Frederick Frankenstein (Gene Wilder) learns that he has inherited his infamous grandfather's estate in Transylvania. Arriving at the castle, Dr. Frankenstein soon begins to recreate his grandfather's experiments with the help of servants Igor (Marty Feldman), Inga (Teri Garr) and the fearsome Frau Blücher (Cloris Leachman). After he creates his own monster (Peter Boyle), new complications ensue with the arrival of the doctor's fiancée, Elizabeth (Madeline Kahn). (Comedy) - 1974

Meanwhile, Blackwolf's gentle twin brother, the bearded and sage Avatar (Bob Holt), calls upon his own magical abilities to foil Blackwolf's plans for world domination -- even if it means destroying his own flesh and blood. fxm.us.title: The Unholy
fxm.us.description: A girl inexplicably gains the power to heal the sick after a supposed visitation from the Virgin Mary. As word spreads and people flock to witness her miracles, a disgraced journalist visits the small New England town to investigate. However, when strange events start to occur, he soon wonders if these phenomena are the result of something more sinister. (Horror, Thriller) - 2021

fxm.us.title: Tarot
fxm.us.description: Friends unwittingly unleash an unspeakable evil trapped within a cursed deck of tarot cards. One by one, they come face to face with fate, racing against death to escape the future foretold in their readings. (Horror, Thriller) - 2024

fxm.us.title: The Happening
fxm.us.description: An apocalyptic threat to humanity arrives out of the clear blue sky with a series of violent, inexplicable deaths spreading across the country. The cause of the terrifying phenomenon remains unknown, prompting science teacher Elliot Moore (Mark Wahlberg), his wife Alma (Zooey Deschanel) and his colleague Julian (John Leguizamo) to try to elude the invisible killer in Pennsylvania's farmland. Soon it becomes clear that no one is safe. (Science fiction, Thriller) - 2008

bbcamerica.us.title: Law & Order - Double Blind
bbcamerica.us.description: A mentally ill college student participating in experimental drug research becomes a suspect in a janitor's murder. (Crime drama, Mystery, Thriller) - 1996-11-06

bbcamerica.us.title: Law & Order - Deadbeat
bbcamerica.us.description: Briscoe and Curtis investigate the murder of an underhanded used-car salesman who was wanted for unpaid child support. (Crime drama, Mystery, Thriller) - 1996-11-13

bbcamerica.us.title: Wild Patagonia - Heat and Dust
bbcamerica.us.description: Follows the path of a relentless wind from the Andes' peaks, that sweeps east through Patagonia's dry desert; the world of maras and desert-dwelling penguins; the first faltering steps of baby guanacos. (Documentary, Nature, Animals) - 2015-10-02

bbcamerica.us.title: Planet Earth - Mountains
bbcamerica.us.description: Touring the mightiest mountain ranges. (Science, Educational, Documentary, Nature, History) - 2006-03-12

bbcamerica.us.title: Planet Earth - Seasonal Forests
bbcamerica.us.description: The trees of the Taiga forest; giant sequoia, the largest living thing on the planet. (Science, Educational, Documentary, Nature, History) - 2006-12-03

bbcamerica.us.title: Planet Earth - From Pole to Pole
bbcamerica.us.description: Traveling around the Earth, finding where the sun always shines and where it's rarely seen; finding where water is abundant and where it's scarce. (Science, Educational, Documentary, Nature, History) - 2006-03-05

bbcamerica.us.title: Land of the Dead
bbcamerica.us.description: In a world where zombies form the majority of the population, the remaining humans build a feudal society away from the undead. Ruthless Paul Kaufman (Dennis Hopper) rules and protects this microcosm but enforces painful class distinctions. Second-in-command Cholo DeMora (John Leguizamo) attempts to lead a secret rebellion against Kaufman's tyranny, but when the zombies begin to evolve, the survivors must discover a way to protect themselves from a zombie horde that can learn and adapt. (Horror) - 2005

bbcamerica.us.title: Shaun of the Dead
bbcamerica.us.description: Shaun is a 30-something loser with a dull, easy existence. When he's not working at the electronics store, he lives with his slovenly best friend, Ed, in a small flat on the outskirts of London. The only unpredictable element in his life is his girlfriend, Liz, who wishes desperately for Shaun to grow up and be a man. When the town is inexplicably overrun with zombies, Shaun must rise to the occasion and protect both Liz and his mother. (Comedy, Horror) - 2004

bbcamerica.us.title: Army of Darkness
bbcamerica.us.description: 3rd Evil Dead movie. Ash finds himself trapped in medieval times. He must quest for the Necronomicon, a book of evil which can return him to his time. Unfortunately, he releases the evil trapped inside the book and unleashes an army of the dead. (Fantasy, Adventure, Horror, Comedy) - 1992

bbcamerica.us.title: The Return of the Living Dead
bbcamerica.us.description: When foreman Frank (James Karen) shows new employee Freddy (Thom Mathews) a secret military experiment in a supply warehouse, the two klutzes accidentally release a gas that reanimates corpses into flesh-eating zombies. As the epidemic spreads throughout Louisville, Ky., and the creatures satisfy their hunger in gory and outlandish ways, Frank and Freddy fight to survive with the help of their boss (Clu Gulager) and a mysterious mortician (Don Calfa). (Horror, Comedy) - 1985

bbcamerica.us.title: Night of the Living Dead
bbcamerica.us.description: For reasons unknown, the recently deceased are rising from the grave as flesh-hungry zombies. Fleeing from the undead horde, a small group of survivors, including Barbara (Patricia Tallman), Ben (Tony Todd) and Harry (Tom Towles), sequester themselves in a remote farmhouse. With the zombies outside the house multiplying, tensions flare, as the group argues over the best way to escape their increasingly dire situation before they are overrun completely. (Horror) - 1990

bbcamerica.us.title: Pet Sematary
bbcamerica.us.description: Doctor Louis Creed (Dale Midkiff) moves his family to Maine, where he meets a friendly local named Jud Crandall (Fred Gwynne). After the Creeds' cat is accidentally killed, Crandall advises Louis to bury it in the ground near the old pet cemetery. The cat returns to life, its personality changed for the worse. When Louis' son, Gage (Miko Hughes), dies tragically, Louis decides to bury the boy's body in the same ground despite the warnings of Crandall and Louis' visions of a deceased patient. (Horror, Thriller) - 1989

bbcamerica.us.title: Pet Sematary Two
bbcamerica.us.description: A teen (Edward Furlong) and his buddy take a shot-dead dog to a sacred burial ground where it comes back to life, riled. - 1992

bbcamerica.us.title: Criminal Minds - A Family Affair
bbcamerica.us.description: The BAU goes to Atlanta to investigate a series of murders, which they believe are being committed by more than one unsub.

bbcamerica.us.title: Criminal Minds - I Love You, Tommy Brown
bbcamerica.us.description: Multiple married couples fostering young children are murdered in Seattle; Garcia worries that Kevin is about to propose.

bbcamerica.us.title: Criminal Minds - Foundation
bbcamerica.us.description: When a young boy is found in the Arizona desert and another goes missing, the team searches for the kidnapper; Morgan draws on his difficult past to connect with the found child.

bbcamerica.us.title: Criminal Minds - Heathridge Manor
bbcamerica.us.description: The team investigates a series of gothic, ritualistic murders in Oregon.

bbcamerica.us.title: Criminal Minds - The Company
bbcamerica.us.description: When Morgan's sister sees a woman who looks like their presumed-dead cousin, the BAU reopens the case of her disappearance.

bbcamerica.us.title: Criminal Minds - Divining Rod
bbcamerica.us.description: After an infamous serial murderer is executed, women in the same Oklahoma town are attacked by a copycat; Prentiss gets nervous about making a major real estate purchase.

bbcamerica.us.title: Hidden Habitats - Australia's Red Centre
bbcamerica.us.description: The Red Center of Australia, though home to an inhospitable environment, also has an array of wildlife.

bbcamerica.us.title: Planet Earth III - Coasts
bbcamerica.us.description: Sir David Attenborough explores the dangerous frontiers created by the world's coasts, where animals fight for survival amid constant change; there are some unexpected residents on Namibia's Skeleton Coast.

bbcamerica.us.title: Planet Earth III - Ocean
bbcamerica.us.description: Sir David Attenborough reveals new animal behaviors in the ocean.

bbcamerica.us.title: Night of the Living Dead
bbcamerica.us.description: For unknown reasons, the recently deceased are rising from the grave as flesh-hungry zombies. A small group of survivors flees from the undead horde and takes refuge in a remote farmhouse. - 1990

bbcamerica.us.title: Graveyard Shift
bbcamerica.us.description: The owner (Stephen Macht) of an ancient mill hires a drifter (David Andrews) to rid the basement of rats. - 1990

bbcamerica.us.title: Thinner
bbcamerica.us.description: An elderly Gypsy king's (Michael Constantine) weight-loss curse prompts an obese lawyer (Robert John Burke) to call in a mob boss's (Joe Mantegna) debt. - 1996

bbcamerica.us.title: Pet Sematary
bbcamerica.us.description: A family's life in small-town Maine is shattered by the evil unleashed from an ancient American Indian burial ground. - 1989

bbcamerica.us.title: Pet Sematary Two
bbcamerica.us.description: A teen (Edward Furlong) and his buddy take a shot-dead dog to a sacred burial ground where it comes back to life, riled. - 1992

bbcamerica.us.title: Misery
bbcamerica.us.description: After a serious car crash, novelist Paul Sheldon (James Caan) is rescued by former nurse Annie Wilkes (Kathy Bates), who claims to be his biggest fan. Annie brings him to her remote cabin to recover, where her obsession takes a dark turn when she discovers Sheldon is killing off her favorite character from his novels. As Sheldon devises plans for escape, Annie grows increasingly controlling, even violent, as she forces the author to shape his writing to suit her twisted fantasies. (Horror, Thriller) - 1990

bbcamerica.us.title: Christine
bbcamerica.us.description: Unpopular nerd Arnie Cunningham (Keith Gordon) buys a 1958 Plymouth Fury, which he names Christine. Arnie develops an unhealthy obsession with the car, to the alarm of his jock friend, Dennis Guilder (John Stockwell). After bully Buddy Repperton (William Ostrander) defaces Christine, the auto restores itself to perfect condition and begins killing off Buddy and his friends. Determined to stop the deaths, Dennis and Arnie's girlfriend, Leigh Cabot (Alexandra Paul), decide to destroy Christine. (Horror) - 1983

buzzr.us.title: The Price Is Right
buzzr.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes. (Game show) - 1972-09-04

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters International
hgtvwest.us.description: S207 E12 French Dream in Les 7 Vallées A mother and daughter duo are ready to ditch Nashville to chase a dream in Les 7 Vallées, France. Mom wants traditional French charm and doesn't mind projects, but her daughter prefers something modern that's turnkey.

hgtvwest.us.title: Love It or List It

hgtvwest.us.title: Love It or List It

hgtvwest.us.title: Renovation Aloha

hgtvwest.us.title: Renovation Aloha

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters International

She's ready to pay for peace and a view, but he's staring a new business and wants to keep expenses as low.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters International

Molly shows Carson all the good his family is able to provide.

showtimewest.us.title: Pulp Fiction
showtimewest.us.description: Two hit men (John Travolta, Samuel L. Jackson), a boxer, a crime boss and others meet their fates over the course of two days.

showtimewest.us.title: Crimes of the Future
showtimewest.us.description: As the human species adapts to a synthetic environment, the body undergoes new transformations and mutations. Accompanied by his partner, celebrity performance artist Saul Tenser showcases the metamorphosis of his organs.

showtimewest.us.title: Paranormal Activity
showtimewest.us.description: A young couple (Katie Featherston, Micah Sloat) move into their first new home but are disturbed by what appears to be a supernatural presence that is most active at night.

showtimewest.us.title: House at the End of the Street
showtimewest.us.description: A divorcee (Elisabeth Shue) and her daughter (Jennifer Lawrence) learn that they have moved next door to a house in which a girl killed her parents, then disappeared, leaving a brother (Max Thieriot) as the only survivor.

showtimewest.us.title: Mimic
showtimewest.us.description: Married scientists (Mira Sorvino, Jeremy Northam) battle killer cockroaches that develop the ability to assume human form.

showtimewest.us.title: Mimic 2
showtimewest.us.description: Investigating three faceless corpses, a detective (Bruno Campos) considers a teacher (Alix Koromzay) at an inner-city high school the prime suspect.

showtimewest.us.title: Paycheck
showtimewest.us.description: After learning that his memory has been erased, a technical wizard (Ben Affleck) goes on the run to piece together clues from his past.

showtimewest.us.title: Gone Baby Gone
showtimewest.us.description: Two private investigators (Casey Affleck, Michelle Monaghan) tread dangerous ground as they scour the Boston underworld for a kidnapped child.

showtimewest.us.title: Double Jeopardy
showtimewest.us.description: In an insurance scam, a man fakes his death and sets his wife up to take the blame. After serving 10 years in prison, she sets out to get revenge, immune from the law since she cannot be re-prosecuted for the same crime.

showtimewest.us.title: Jack Reacher
showtimewest.us.description: A defense attorney hires an enigmatic ex-Army investigator to tackle the case of a highly trained sniper who apparently murdered five people at random.

showtimewest.us.title: Jack Reacher: Never Go Back
showtimewest.us.description: Investigator Jack Reacher (Tom Cruise) goes on the lam to uncover the truth behind a major government conspiracy that involves the death of U.S. soldiers.

showtimewest.us.title: Edge of Tomorrow
showtimewest.us.description: A soldier fighting aliens gets to relive the same day over and over again, the day restarting every time he dies.

showtimewest.us.title: Godzilla
showtimewest.us.description: Godzilla, King of the Monsters, arises to combat massive, malevolent foes that have been feeding on a nuclear plant's reactors and now threaten mankind with total annihilation.

showtimewest.us.title: Shutter Island
showtimewest.us.description: A 1950s lawman (Leonardo DiCaprio) pursues a murderess who appears to have vanished from a locked room within a fortresslike psychiatric hospital.

showtimewest.us.title: The Ring
showtimewest.us.description: A journalist (Naomi Watts) investigates the mystery behind a bizarre videotape that brings death after seven days to all who view it.

showtimewest.us.title: King Kong
showtimewest.us.description: An oil explorer (Charles Grodin), a zoologist (Jeff Bridges) and a shipwrecked blonde (Jessica Lange) capture a huge ape leading to a battle atop the World Trade Center.

showtimewest.us.title: Pretty Red Dress
showtimewest.us.description: The story of Travis, Candice and their daughter, Kenisha, and their relationships with the same red dress.

showtimewest.us.title: The Saint
showtimewest.us.description: A clever thief who is known as the master of creating false identities using the names of Catholic saints, is hired by the Russian Mafia for his next mission. But things get complicated when he falls for Emma Russel, the scientist.

showtimewest.us.title: Blade Runner 2049
showtimewest.us.description: After discovering a long-buried secret that jeopardizes what's left of society, a new Blade Runner embarks on a quest to find Rick Deckard, a former Blade Runner who's been missing for 30 years.

showtimewest.us.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Mighty Cruise Ships

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Build That?
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S05E04 Tunnels & Towers In Chicago, twin concrete towers push the limits of high-rise design. Engineers conquer the sea to unite Sweden and Denmark. And in Sydney, Norman Foster and team take on the challenge of a new metro station that can't disrupt the busy streets above. (Episode, Series, How-to)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Build That?
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S04E08 Facelifts & Scaffolds A museum building bends 1,100-glass tubes to form a facade and tunnels below the water table; a vast 11-storey glass atrium HQ is built on the former Berlin Wall site to represent unity. (Episode, Series, How-to)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Build That?
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S04E07 Summit & Submerge Building an eco-friendly visitor center in the permafrost on Colorado's Pikes Peak tests the team. A museum is constructed in a disused dry dock that's in danger of collapse. (Episode, Series, How-to)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Build That?
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S03E09 Curved & Cables A new performance center with a tent-like glass-and-steel lobby tests engineers in Kansas City; two twisting apartment towers make heads spin in Ontario. (Episode, Series, How-to)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Build That?
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S02E09 Mirrors & Marble Visiting Australia's One Central Park, the Oslo Opera House and the California Academy of Sciences in San Francisco to reveal their architectural secrets. (Episode, Series, How-to)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Build That?
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S03E03 Canyons & Curves Engineers grapple with an apartment building, ripped apart by a man-made canyon; the Gateway Arch takes shape in St. Louis; an unpromising plot in Copenhagen, Denmark, is transformed by a gleaming new triangular office. (Episode, Series, How-to)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Build That?
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S04E01 Space Stations and Super Celebrating one of humanities biggest engineering achievements, the International Space Station, a meteor proof lab bigger than a football field, constructed by astronauts traveling 250 miles above us at 17,500 miles an hour. (Episode, Series, How-to)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Build That?
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S04E10 Floating Parks & Upcycled Towers On inadequate foundations, San Francisco's MoMA triples in size creating an exterior light enough to prevent collapse; a 1970s Sydney skyscraper is recycled into a 21st century tower; in Dallas, a five-acre park is created. (Episode, Series, How-to)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Fix That?

(Episode, Series, Documentary)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Fix That?

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Fix That?
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S01E01 Heli-Logger A crew and its massive air crane helicopter haul millions of pounds of timber while battling the elements and handling emergency repairs. (Episode, Series, Documentary)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Fix That?
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S04E02 Volcano Power Mike is in Iceland, where teams harness the power of volcanos to keep the geothermal energy flowing; they battle harsh weather to maintain and upgrade giant power systems, fixing miles of steam pipes, and bringing a dead well back to life. (Episode, Series, Documentary)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Fix That?

(Episode, Series, Documentary)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Fix That?
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S04E04 Sky Rides In the Alps of Switzerland, Mike helps an elite team install a new cable (rope) system on an iconic mountain gondola line, helps fix the world's steepest cogwheel railway track and explores mountaintop family farms only accessible. (Episode, Series, Documentary)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Fix That?

tlcwest.us.title: One Day in My Body - Small Insights

tlcwest.us.title: Hoarding: Buried Alive - Losing Half Myself

tlcwest.us.title: Hoarding: Buried Alive - Somewhere in My Pile

tlcwest.us.title: Hoarding: Buried Alive - Full of Rats
tlcwest.us.description: Property investors purchase a house that is occupied by a hoarder; rat infestation compromises the building's foundation.

tlcwest.us.title: Hoarding: Buried Alive - You're Gonna Die in Here

tlcwest.us.title: 1000-lb Sisters - Not So Fast Car

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - The King of Open-Fire Paella

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Holy Mackerel!
tastemade.us.description: Andrew Zimmern champions the often-overlooked mackerel with a main salad of pickled filets, charred tomatoes, grilled frisée, and sweet summer peaches. Then, he grills it whole seasoned with caramelized onions, rutabaga mash and charred grapes. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - How to Cook a Whole Pig at Home

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - The Essence of Grill Culture

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Elk Tenderloin Tostadas and Grilled Rack of Ribs

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - The Most Underrated Game Bird

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Grilled Yellowtail Collars & Filets with Miso Sauce

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E29 The Fight Party Episode Nick's boxing match party unexpectedly takes over the family room on the same night Suzanne's book group is meeting in the living room.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E05 The Cooking Episode Nick and Suzanne go head-to-head in the kitchen when Nick says cooking is easy and Suzanne challenges him to a family cooking competition.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E32 The Suzanne's Surprise Party Episode Nick and the kids throw a birthday party for Suzanne because she has never had one.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E23 The Career Day Episode Nick confuses Kevin's classmates when he implies that networking is more important than studying and getting good grades.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E20 The Salsa Episode Annoyed that she and Nick never do anything together as a couple, Suzanne signs the two of them up for salsa lessons, but is surprised by her control issues on the dance floor.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E09 The Green Episode The family decides to go green, but it is much harder than they thought, and they realize sometimes you have to choose between saving the planet and saving your family.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E16 The Ghost Dog Episode The entire family plays pranks on one another, to the chagrin of Suzanne; when the family ignores Nick's choking because they think it's another prank, Nick has a near-death experience and embraces his Zen side.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E02 The We Ain't Going Out Like That Episode Nick tries to be spontaneous; Suzanne resists and plans a date night that fails; they attempt to be spontaneous together until they realize it's better if she plans.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E07 The Suzanne Theft Auto Episode Suzanne becomes overly consumed with Kevin's science project; Lindsey revs up for driving lessons, only to emerge as a suspect when her mother's car is scratched.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E08 The Second Black President Episode Kevin is torn between running a clean campaign for class president and being negative about his opponent.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E31 The Kevin Gets a Commercial Episode Kevin auditions for a commercial for the mall burger joint and ends up being replaced by a famous kid actor that looks just like him.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E46 The Black Friday Episode Comical chaos ensues when the gang waits in line to shop at a department store on Black Friday. Kevin anticipates buying a new video game, Lindsey meets a boy, relationship problems plague Martin and Terrence hopes to buy toys for charity.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E12 The Parent Teacher Trap Episode When Suzanne gets roped into a committee at Kevin's school, where the other mums are mean to her, Nick volunteers to fill in on her behalf, making things awkward when the ladies love him.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E09 The She Got Game Night Episode When the Kingston-Persons decide to have a game night, all bets are off, as unlikely friends are drawn to one another when paired together for games.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E33 The Mother's Day Episode Nick tricks Suzanne and Marilyn into spending a weekend together at a spa for Mother's Day, where it becomes clear it will take more than a masseuse to relieve the tension in the women's relationship.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S01 E02 The Credit Check Episode Nick needs a new van for work, but Suzanne worries they are already too much in debt and cannot afford to buy a new one; Suzanne has some credit issues she has not revealed to Nick.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E03 The Oh No She Di-in't Episode When Nick's new field producer, Sam, turns out to be female, Suzanne is convinced she is trying to steal her man, a suggestion Nick thinks is absurd until Sam actually makes a move on him.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E53 The Good Day Seattle Episode The station launches a new morning show, but Nick's cohost is a self-serving reality star; Marilyn moves in with the family.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S01 E08 The Michelle Obama Sweater Episode Using her mother's credit card, Lindsey gets help from Nick in ordering a Michelle Obama sweater online; Kevin pretends to be sick to pull off a scam to get a signed A-Rod jersey.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E12 The Tiger Dad Episode Nick becomes a more influential parent, so he pushes Kevin and Lindsey hard, and they become model children.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E28 The Nick Hosts a Telethon Episode Despite warnings from other co-workers, Nick gets stuck hosting a charity telethon; Suzanne has to deal with a rich client's boring wedding plans.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E10 The Despicable E Episode Lindsey's romantic attentions turn to a young celebrity DJ, who only neglects her in return; Suzanne teaches Kevin the art of doing laundry.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S01 E06 The Booty Episode Nick goes to watch a game with friends at a sports bar known to have sexy female waitresses; the kids want a larger allowance, but they're not willing to do more chores.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E15 The First .45 Episode When Lindsay tries to turn family members into stars of a reality television show, Kevin makes a discovery that brings too much reality to the Kingston-Persons household.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S01 E04 The Soccer Episode Kevin is a big football fan, but Nick does not understand the appeal; Suzanne is frustrated by Lindsey's lack of communication and creates a fake Facebook account to learn what is going on.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E35 The Life Insurance Episode Although Nick and Suzanne realize that life insurance would be a good decision to protect their family, Nick has reservations about buying a policy.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S01 E07 The Viral Video Episode Suzanne gets caught dancing on a video that soon becomes a huge viral hit; Marilyn decides Lindsey needs to learn how to cook soul food.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E36 The Hypertension Episode When Nick gets a doctor's report that he has high blood pressure, Suzanne does everything she can to make sure his stress levels stay low.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E25 The Mr. Almost Episode When Nick happens upon an old college pal, the unexpected meeting gives rise to a business plan that involves a sports star and an energy drink; the results are not so bubbly.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E28 The Liar, Liar Episode Suzanne begins to force everyone in the family to tell the truth at all times after she catches Nick in a lie.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E34 The Secret Episode Lindsey has a new crush and Gigi has a new boyfriend, but when certain secrets cannot be kept, a web of misinformation nearly ruins both situations.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E17 The Lemon Squeeze Episode When the family's morning routine devolves into fighting, Gigi suggests that they try an old sorority exercise called the Lemon Squeeze in order to turn their problems around.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E31 The Kwandanegaba Children's Fund Episode Nick wants Lindsey and Kevin to give back to the community, so they select a charity they find online; when the charity keeps asking for more money, Nick has to get to the bottom of it.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E21 The V.I.P. Tickets Episode Suzanne is furious when Nick invites Martin and not her to a baseball game; Kevin and Lindsey try to win tickets to Rihanna's Los Angeles concert.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E01 The Staycation Episode When Nick messes up Suzanne's plans for spring break, he turns the house into a makeshift resort, and promises to give the family the best vacation ever.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E23 The Compatibility Test Episode Suzanne meets a relationship adviser and becomes convinced that she and Nick are having compatibility issues.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E26 The Big Loan Episode Confusion ensues when Suzanne asks Marilyn for a loan in an attempt to keep her birthday present a secret for Nick.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E15 The Control Issue Episode When Nick points out that Suzanne has issues letting go of controlling everything, Suzanne lets everything go; the family realizes they need Suzanne's controlling ways to run a successful household.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E48 The Concussion Episode After a concussion, Nick is advised to not go to bed for a few hours; to avoid all risks, he attempts to stay up all night.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E19 The Disney Episode Nick is invited to play in a celebrity golf tournament at Walt Disney World; Suzanne has to miss the family's first vacation.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E04 The 22 Episode When the family oversleeps on the morning Lindsey is set to sing the National Anthem at a baseball game, it is all hands on deck just to make it to out of the house on time.

cinevault.us.title: Family Business
cinevault.us.description: Vito (Dustin Hoffman) is the son of Jessie (Sean Connery), a professional criminal who has trained his son in the craft. With the birth of his own son, Adam (Matthew Broderick), Vito decides to reform his life. When he's in college, Adam's family's shady lifestyle seduces him, and with the help of his grandfather, he plans an elaborate burglary for the family to pull off together. When Adam is arrested during the heist, Jessie and Vito must make sacrifices in order to ensure the boy's future. (Comedy drama, Movie) - 1989-12-30

cinevault.us.title: She's Out of Control
cinevault.us.description: A Los Angeles radio-station manager's (Tony Danza) girlfriend (Catherine Hicks) shows his teenage daughter (Ami Dolenz) how to be sexy. (Comedy, Movie) - 1989-04-14

cinevault.us.title: Life Without Dick
cinevault.us.description: After consulting a fortuneteller, painter Colleen (Sarah Jessica Parker) begins to suspect that her private-eye boyfriend, Dick (Johnny Knoxville), is cheating. When she comes home and finds him packing to leave her, Colleen accidentally kills him. Nervous Irish Mafia hit man Daniel (Harry Connick Jr.), who's been gunning for Dick, arrives shortly afterward and admits he has never successfully completed a job. Daniel proposes to take credit for the murder, and the odd couple fall in love. (Movie, Romantic comedy) - 2001

cinevault.us.title: The Deep
cinevault.us.description: Undersea adventure about a couple who become involved in a dangerous conflict with treasure hunters when they discover a deadly shipwreck in Bermudan waters. When they realize that the cache includes morphine, the pair enlist the help of an old treasure hunter to escape the drug dealers who hid their product amidst the sunken wreck. (Adventure, Movie, Mystery, Thriller) - 1977-06-17

cinevault.us.title: Hardwired
cinevault.us.description: After surviving a car crash that kills his pregnant wife, Luke Gibson (Cuba Gooding Jr.) wakes up in the hospital with complete amnesia. He's been severely injured, but is alive thanks to a groundbreaking brain implant from a powerful multinational corporation. As Luke recovers, he starts to realize his implant is dangerous and seeks help from Hal (Michael Ironside), the leader of a group of hackers. A shadowy executive (Val Kilmer) tries to stop Luke and Hal before they learn too much. (Action, Movie, Science fiction, Thriller) - 2009-11-03

cinevault.us.title: Half Past Dead
cinevault.us.description: Criminal mastermind Donny/49er One (Morris Chestnut) has set in motion a plan to infiltrate a high-tech prison in order to persuade a death row inmate to reveal the whereabouts of $200 million worth of gold. Undercover FBI agent Sascha (Steven Seagal) must stop him before it's too late. (Action, Movie, Thriller) - 2002-11-15

combatwarchannel.us.title: Mission Invisible
combatwarchannel.us.description: Joining the 130-man crew aboard the pride of the Russian northern fleet, a Typhoon-class submarine, as they embark on a top secret military mission.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Battlefields
combatwarchannel.us.description: S02 E03 Second Battle Of The Aisne April 16, 1917; all the Poilus who attack that day are sure that this will be the end of the war; the offensive decided by the new commander-in-chief, General Nivelle, must take everything on its passage.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Artillery: The God of War
combatwarchannel.us.description: Exploring the battlefield history of artillery and advances in both technology and ballistics.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Naval Warfare in World War II
combatwarchannel.us.description: S02 E12 Kamikaze Japan's last resort comes down to suicide pilots called Kamikaze; they are men who willingly crash their planes into ships in order to destroy the American spirit.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Wheels of Power: History of Official Cars
combatwarchannel.us.description: An exploration of the vehicles used by heads of state and other people in power.

combatwarchannel.us.title: The Concise History of WWII
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E02 From Germany's dramatic invasion of Poland, France, and Russia, to the Battle of Britain, the key battles in Africa, the attack of Pearl Harbor and the eventual defeat of the Nazi army in Stalingrad.

combatwarchannel.us.title: WWII: The Road To Victory
combatwarchannel.us.description: Pentagon Commanders General George C. Marshall and Henry 'Hap' Arnold are profiled.

combatwarchannel.us.title: World of Warships Clash of Titans
combatwarchannel.us.description: S02 E04 Mers-El-Kebir On July 3, 1940, the British fleet attacks the French navy at Mers el-Kébir, Algeria; in ten minutes, Bretagne sank, Mogador was destroyed, and Provence and Dunkerque were grounded.

combatwarchannel.us.title: The Goering catalog
combatwarchannel.us.description: A look at how NAZI official Hermann Goering amassed a collection of over 5,000 art works, all meticulously detailed in a catalog, over the course of a decade.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Sacrifice: From D-Day to the Liberation of Paris
combatwarchannel.us.description: The Allies secure the landing beaches of Normandy on June 6, 1944; the pivotal battle for the coast is over, but the real mission has just begun.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Living in the Shadow of World War Two
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E03 Happy Days Combatant countries go to great lengths to maintain their people's morale, offering diversion and entertainment while reassuring citizens that their cause is just and victory certain.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Battlezone: The Vietnam War
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E26 No Substitute for Victory Video produced during the Vietnam War when the Communist threat was at its height.

combatwarchannel.us.title: The Rise and Fall of Adolf Hitler
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E03 Why Hitler Lost WWII Examines the enormous sacrifice the free world paid to defeat Nazi Germany and analyzes Adolf Hitler's thirst for power and his bumbling military errors, including letting the BEF escape at Dunkirk.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Auschwitz - Voices of 44 Survivors
combatwarchannel.us.description: The concentration camp deportees became the rare witnesses to mass extermination.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Soviet Storm
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E06 Operation Bagration Soviet operation to attack the occupying Germans in the Belorussian SSR.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Architects of Darkness
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E04 Hermann Goering The drug addicted dilettante who created the Luftwaffe, Hermann Goering was at Hitler's side from the ill-fated Beer Hall putsch of 1923 until the estrangement between the two in April 1945 when Hitler ordered Goering's arrest.

combatwarchannel.us.title: WWII: The Road To Victory
combatwarchannel.us.description: Marine Commanders The leaders of the Pacific Chester M. Nimitz and Douglas MacArthur are discussed.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Battle for Cassino
combatwarchannel.us.description: Soldiers from 15 nations fight and die landing in Italy in 1943 and capturing Rome in 1944.

Now, three desperate parties want the money -- and they have exactly 90 minutes to find it and get out alive. (Action, Thriller) - 2021

filmriseaction.us.title: American Yakuza

filmriseaction.us.title: Code Name Banshee

Now, they must put the past behind them and join together one last time to fight off the secret CIA-backed killers who threaten to destroy them. (Action, Drama) - 2022

filmriseaction.us.title: Derailed

Kristoff tells his disappointed wife, son and daughter that he's taking a business trip. They decide to sneak aboard the train as a surprise, only to suspect he's having an affair with the mysterious Galina. To make matters much worse, terrorists hijack the train and go after the virus. (Action, Thriller) - 2002

filmriseaction.us.title: In Hell

Unfortunately for Kyle, he is assigned to a prison that is renowned for its violence. Controlled by a corrupt and sadistic warden, the facility regularly holds brutal fights between inmates. ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E01 Queer gothic writers Mary Shelley, Oscar Wilde and Bram Stoker invent the horror genre with "Frankenstein," "The Picture of Dorian Gray" and "Dracula"; when cinema arrives, queer director F.W. Murnau shocks the world with his queer-coded "Nosferatu."

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Queer for Fear: The History of Queer Horror
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E02 Gay director James Whale makes four classics that pave the way for all Hollywood horror movies after, but his career was dimmed by anti-gay sentiment; Alfred Hitchcock uses queer characters and queer coded stories to keep audiences in suspense.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Queer for Fear: The History of Queer Horror
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E03 Werewolves, cat people, body-snatchers and doppelgängers are uniquely queer metaphors; from the classic "The Wolf Man" to queer-authored "Cat People," the monsters of the 1940s express shame and seek to rid themselves of the secret self.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Queer for Fear: The History of Queer Horror
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E04 The dangerous queer woman has been terrorizing horror audiences since before the dawn of cinema; the lesbian vampire sucks the lifeblood from women and men alike in the gothic novella "Carmilla" and films like "Dracula's Daughter."

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Eli Roth's History of Horror
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S02 E01 Houses of Hell Home is where the heart is, unless one lives in a house of hell; whether they're filled with specters or psychos, every house of hell pokes at illusions of comfort and safety.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Eli Roth's History of Horror
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S02 E02 Monsters The history of monster movies is also the history of the evolution of special effects technology; whatever their size or shape and whatever they represent, for many horror fans monsters are the best part of the genre.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Eli Roth's History of Horror
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S02 E03 Body Horror Sometimes disgusting, body horror films make audience members question their prejudices against physical difference, their attitudes about sex and gender, their fear of disease and contamination, and how much appearance determines destiny.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Eli Roth's History of Horror
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S02 E04 Witches The witch is a towering figure in the history of horror; the archetypical evil witch is everything mainstream religion tells believers a woman should not be -- and that unapologetic, very female power frightens men and fascinates women.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Eli Roth's History of Horror
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S02 E05 Chilling Children Parents are supposed to love their children, no matter how awful their kids may be; the films highlighted in this episode may not solve the mystery of where evil comes from, but they have a terrifically terrifying time raising the question.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Eli Roth's History of Horror
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S02 E06 Nine Nightmares A deep dive into nine films that defy categorization and push the boundaries of horror; great films that entertain and provoke audiences; films that put society under a microscope, making people question not just what they fear, but why they fear it.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Cursed Films
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E02 Poltergeist A series of untimely deaths connected to the making of the "Poltergeist" films inspire rumors that the production is cursed; suspicions are stoked by rumors that real human skeletons were used during the making of the film.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: The Preppy Murder: Death in Central Park
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E01 Part 1: Woman Down in Central Park The NYPD identifies a dead girl in Central Park as Jennifer Levin; the search for her killer leads to her prep school friend Robert Chambers; Robert confesses he killed Jennifer Levin accidentally during rough sex.

paranormalfiles.us.description: Some people think everything is a conspiracy. Luckily for them, the FBI declassified decades' worth of government documents in April 2011, allowing people to gain more insight behind some of the most popular conspiracy theories. Each episode of this series investigates a compelling theory by opening these and other files. After acquiring new information, the show's team of specialists re-examines faulty assumptions, looks for inconsistencies and explores new leads in an attempt to get to the bottom of each case. Just make sure you have your tin foil handy when watching the show. (Documentary, Paranormal) - 2012-09-17

paranormalfiles.us.title: The Conspiracy Show
paranormalfiles.us.description: Many believe that there are things in this world that aren't made public that the average person isn't supposed to know about. The truth may be hidden, but there are some people, like host Richard Syrett, who investigate these conspiracies and try to uncover the secrets. "The Conspiracy Show" examines claims of supernatural creatures, political cover-ups, medical discoveries, extraterrestrial life, paranormal phenomena and other unexplained mysteries. Using interviews with top researchers, skeptics, independent thinkers and authors, Syrett is determined to uncover the truth to some of the most extraordinary claims of conspiracy. (Documentary, Paranormal) - 2011-02-18

paranormalfiles.us.description: In April 2011 the FBI declassified decades' worth of secret government documents that contain thousands of reports of UFO sightings and alien activity. Each episode of this half-hour series tackles one alien case by investigating the previously off-limits government files. The program re-examines key evidence and follows developing leads based on newly released information. outlaw.us.title: Wild Rovers
outlaw.us.description: Tired of his job at a ranch owned by Walter Buckman (Karl Malden), Frank Post (Ryan O'Neal) wants to pull a heist, and when his much older coworker, Ross Bodine (William Holden), sees nothing better on the horizon, the cowboys agree to team up for the crime. After filling their pockets with loot from a local bank, Frank and Ross ride toward what they hope is freedom. But the younger Buckmans, Paul (Joe Don Baker) and John (Tom Skerritt), pursue them over the rough land of the Southwest. (Western) - 1971

outlaw.us.title: They Died With Their Boots On
outlaw.us.description: George Armstrong Custer (Errol Flynn) is a rebellious but ambitious soldier, eager to join the Civil War. During the war, Custer has numerous successes to his credit, even though he disobeys orders. After the war concludes, he marries Libby Bacon (Olivia de Havilland) and is assigned to the Dakota Territory. Custer negotiates honestly with the Sioux on land, but due to corruption from others, a battle with Sitting Bull's forces occurs at Little Big Horn. (Western) - 1941

outlaw.us.title: Cahill, United States Marshal
outlaw.us.description: A U.S. marshal (John Wayne) neglects his two sons and finds them mixed up with an outlaw (George Kennedy) in a bank robbery. (Western) - 1973

outlaw.us.title: A Big Hand for the Little Lady
outlaw.us.description: When a yearly high-stakes poker game begins between the five richest men in Laredo, Texas, all other activity in the Wild West town comes to a stop as everyone gathers to watch the action. Recovering gambler Meredith (Henry Fonda), passing through town on the way to San Antonio, gets roped into the game by lawyer Otto Habershaw (Kevin McCarthy). When the stress of the game becomes too much to bear, his disapproving wife, Mary (Joanne Woodward), must step in to save the family fortune. (Western, Comedy) - 1966

outlaw.us.title: Tension at Table Rock
outlaw.us.description: When locals are wrongfully led to believe that Wes Tancred murdered a gunslinger in cold blood, they exile the innocent man. Tancred sets off in search of a new start and arrives in the dusty hamlet of Table Rock -- only to find his reputation has preceded him. To avoid trouble, Tancred uses an assumed name. But, when Sheriff Fred Miller talks of trouble at the hands of a violent gang, Tancred agrees to be deputized, and struggles for his shot at redemption. (Western) - 1956

outlaw.us.title: The Sheepman
outlaw.us.description: Sheep farmer Jason Sweet (Glenn Ford) arrives in a small Western cattle town and promptly clashes with local tough guy Jumbo McCall (Mickey Shaughnessy). He also irks Stephen Bedford (Leslie Nielsen), a wealthy cattleman, with his advances toward Bedford's girlfriend, Dell Payton (Shirley MacLaine). With the entire town in an uproar over Sweet's behavior, Bedford arranges for Chocktaw Neal (Pernell Roberts), a seasoned gunslinger, to shoot him down. (Western, Comedy) - 1958

outlaw.us.title: The Last Challenge
outlaw.us.description: Hotshot gunfighter Lot McGuire intends to make a name for himself by out-duelling legendary bandit-turned-lawman Marshal Dan Blaine. Before any bullets fly, however, Lot and his intended enemy strike up an unlikely friendship, and Blaine tries to convince the youngster to call off the shootout. Unfortunately, Lot can't be talked out of his quest for glory, and so he guns down a few hostile locals, leaving Blaine no choice but to finally accept the offer for a showdown. (Western) - 1967

outtvproud.us.title: Bug
outtvproud.us.description: At a rundown desert motel, Agnes (Ashley Judd) begins a tentative relationship with a newcomer named Peter (Michael Shannon). He has a strange charisma, one that offers fearful and unstable Agnes a flicker of hope. When Peter reveals that the military deliberately infected him with a bug and that he has tiny insects crawling under his skin, paranoia begins to envelop the desperate pair. (Drama, Thriller, Horror) - 2006

outtvproud.us.title: Cyborg 2: Glass Shadow
outtvproud.us.description: A cyborg designed to appear convincingly human, Casella "Cash" Reese (Angelina Jolie) is a spy and assassin for the massive Pinwheel Corporation. Set to ultimately self-destruct, Cash attempts to evade her fate with the aid of martial-arts expert and trainer Colson "Colt" Ricks (Elias Koteas) and a rebellious fellow cyborg named Mercy (Jack Palance). Naturally, the company doesn't want to lose one of their prize assets, so the ruthless Daniel Bench (Billy Drago) is sent to track Cash down. (Science fiction, Action, Thriller) - 1993

outtvproud.us.title: Mannequin Two: On the Move
outtvproud.us.description: Although Jason (William Ragsdale) works as a department store clerk, he is also a reincarnated prince. Long ago, his beloved Jessie (Kristy Swanson) was snatched away from him by an evil wizard (Terry Kiser) who used his powers to transform her into wooden statue. Now Jessie is in Jason's department store as a mannequin. When he encounters her, she awakens from her thousand-year sleep. They quickly revive their romance, but the evil wizard has been reincarnated as well, and he's up to no good. (Fantasy, Comedy, Romance) - 1991

outtvproud.us.title: Coming Soon
outtvproud.us.description: Privileged teenage friends Jenny (Gaby Hoffmann), Nell (Tricia Vessey) and Stream (Bonnie Root) spend their senior year on a quest to rid Stream of her virginity. However, Stream wants more than just her first sexual experience. She wants to have an orgasm -- but achieving this proves problematic, as the boys she meets are hardly sensitive enough to provide her the release she seeks. When it becomes clear that Nell and Jenny have never experienced an orgasm either, all three set out to get one. (Romantic comedy, LGBTQ) - 1999

outtvproud.us.title: Jackie's Back!
outtvproud.us.description: A British documentarian (Tim Curry) profiles a washed-up diva (Jenifer Lewis) as she prepares for her comeback concert. (Comedy) - 1999

outtvproud.us.title: Cruel Intentions
outtvproud.us.description: Annette (Reese Witherspoon) unwittingly becomes a pawn in Sebastian's (Ryan Phillippe) and Kathryn's (Sarah Michelle Gellar) deliciously diabolical wager of sexual conquest when she writes an article in Seventeen Magazine about how she intends to stay pure until she marries her boyfriend. However, Sebastian gets more than he bargained for as he attempts to woo Annette into his bed. (Drama) - 1999

outtvproud.us.title: Earth Girls Are Easy

Once the furry beings are shaved at her girlfriend's salon, the women discover three handsome men underneath. After absorbing the native culture via television, the spacemen are ready to hit the dating scene in the 1980s Los Angeles. (Musical comedy, Romance) - 1989

outtvproud.us.title: Backtrack

She reports the murder to the local police, but they are unable to protect her from Mafia don Lino Avoca (Vincent Price), who orders hitman Milo (Dennis Hopper) to track her down and kill her. Anne changes her identity, moves to Seattle and builds a new life, while Milo, preparing for his mission, becomes increasingly obsessed with her. When he finally finds Anne, Milo needs to decide what his next move will be. (Thriller, Comedy) - 1989

outtvproud.us.title: Wisegirls

Soon, Meg befriends coworkers Raychel and Kate and begins a new life. tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E03 A Dream Childhood Home Lauren's childhood home needs big help to become the grown up family home for her, Kyle and their two boys, while real estate agent Odane needs expert staging to help his clients sell high, and buy their dream home.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E05 Farm to Table Andrea and David are foodies, but hosting in their "builder basic" yard is no fun. Brian and Sarah make their farm-to-table dreams come true, with a veggie garden, dining room, BBQ zone, and a play space for their 2 kids.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E03 Cozy Leather Cabin Workshop Brian and Sarah create a backyard for Pam & Kevin that matches their lush forest surrounding complete with a double wrap around deck and a hot tub. The team also build a workshop for Kevin to perfect his craft of leather tooling.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E05 Wellness Wonderland Breanna & Nick's life revolves around socializing and physical activity. Brian and Sarah convert an old, underused shed into a beautiful, zen'd out yoga studio and create backyard partying, lounging and dining areas.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E06 Creative Lounge Dave and Jorge love art and entertaining, but with tenants in their basement and no creative space inside, Brian and Sarah turn their backyard into a creative party lounge and build a shipping container-inspired structure for an industrial feel.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E10 Greenhouse Bliss Lynna is a single mom with three teenage kids and the time has come for her to have the back garden of her dreams. Brian and Sarah deliver in spades, with a 3 season hang-out, lush new landscaping, and a beautiful greenhouse.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E09 Social Central Sunroom Sonia & Paul are big social connectors in their community with a constant flow of visitors. Brian and Sarah turn their barren backyard into a social hotspot, complete with sunroom, giant chessboard, waterfall and stylish outdoor entertainment spaces.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E11 Multipurpose Cabana Brian and Sarah build a sun deck, outdoor dining area and a Grecian inspired, 3-season garage conversion.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E02 Family of Five Funhouse Love is large, but space is tight for Lara & Mike and their 5 children. Brian and Sarah free up space by building an activity-packed tree house and recreation court for the children, with grilling, dining and lounging areas for the whole family.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E06 Life-Sized Sister Playhouse Sandra & David's eldest daughter, Harlow, was born with vision challenges and their youngest daughter, Delilah, is just learning to walk. Brian and Sarah build a colorful playland for both children, while also building a decked out BBQ & dining area.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E01 Pub Paradise Bachelor Kyle's father Jack has helped him renovate his new home, but the backyard is still unusable. To help Kyle throw the ultimate housewarming party, Brian and Sarah build a sexy sports pub, a lounge area and a fire pit.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E02 Twins Clubhouse Sham, Ruban and their twin boys aren't using their big, boring backyard. To help this family embrace the great outdoors, Brian and Sarah build a vacation style getaway, with a beach volleyball court and a kid's clubhouse.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E01 A Space For Dancing and Hanging Susan's energetic son, Harrison, has no space to dance at home without getting under his mom's feet. Brian and Sarah build a hang-out / dance space for Harrison and create a California-inspired pool and lounge area for Susan.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E03 Rustic Barn Rehab Becki, Shawn and their 3 kids just moved from the city to a smaller country home. To extend their living space, Brian and Sarah build a new deck, a fire pit area, and a 3-season living space, in their first ever barn rehab.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E06 His and Hers Hideaway Miriam and Mark are busy parents to four kids under 10 years old. To help these hardworking parents unwind, Brian and Sarah build them a parents-only hideaway in their backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E11 Sports & Social Zone France & Marc's home is being outgrown by their sport-obsessed sons and provides no inspiring space for France to work from home. Brian and Sarah convert a rundown garage into a spot where France can work and carved out safe sports areas.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E02 Creative Shipping Container Kirsten works from the home office, while Joel is a sales representative with a make-shift workspace in their bedroom. To help this couple, Brian and Sarah look to the backyard for space to retrofit an old shipping container into an office.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E07 Mom's Retreat Melissa and Lee's 3 boys need more room for sports, and Mom needs more peace and quiet! So Brian and Sarah turn the underused backyard into a sports court, a new lounge space, and a luxurious, 3-season Mom's retreat.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E03 Kids Clubhouse Ali and Hana have two very talented young children - and a very noisy and crowded house. To give everyone in this family their own space, Brian and Sarah turn an old garage into a kids' music and arts hangout.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E02 Nana's Wonderland Janet's love for her nine grandkids is endless. But so is the chaos they bring inside her home when they come visit. To take that energy outside, Brian and Sarah build a fun kid-zone in the backyard, but also a sophisticated adult area for Janet.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E08 D.J.'s Den Cool parents, Michelle and Adrian, are passionate about music and events. Brian and Sarah tune into their needs and amp up their boring backyard with a DJ den, a creative arts-and-crafts wall, and hang-out zones for family jam sessions.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E09 Outdoor Kitchen Marlow, Phil, their 3 small kids, and Phil's parents all live in one crowded house. Brian and Sarah transform their yard into a spectacular space for cooking, entertaining and playing.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E14 Modern Woodshop Newlyweds Cheryl and Gavin love their new home, but Cheryl doesn't love the sound of Gavin's woodworking in the garage. Brian and Sarah help by building a dedicated wood shop and some chic new living space in their urban backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E04 Treehouse Village Debbie, Kevin, and their three children are a newly-blended family. To bring this new family together, Brian and Sarah build an irresistible treehouse village in their backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E05 Sports Bar Craig and Claudia share their new space with Craig's brother, Craig's parents - and their two massive dogs. To give these new homeowners a place of their own, Brian and Sarah build a sports bar and entertainment hangout in their backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E06 Neighborhood Party House Nicole and Charles have 3 kids, and their neighborhood parties are getting too big for their front porch. So Brian and Sarah add more entertaining space in the backyard, plus a 4-season garage conversion with a nautical theme.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E08 Cottage in the City Steve and Tanya are Realtors who just bought their forever home a few doors down from Tanya's parents. To complete their dream home, Brian and Sarah build a dream cottage retreat in their backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E08 Craft Studio Jenn and Josh don't have enough space in their semi-detached home to enjoy their hobbies. Brian and Sarah build a stylish lounge space and convert the existing garage into a multipurpose space for crafting and playing guitar.
