truehistory.us.title: War in the Modern World - Nightmare Scenarios of Modern War
truehistory.us.description: The factors that explain why wars between great powers look different nowadays, and explore what future conflicts could look like between the United States and two of its major adversaries. (History, World history) - 2022-10-12

truehistory.us.title: War in the Modern World - The Tools of Modern Warfare
truehistory.us.description: How five contemporary technologies-the Kalashnikov assault rifle, improvised explosive devices, guided missiles, drones, and cyber warfare-redefined the rules of battle and leveled the playing field between world powers and insurgent groups. (History, World history) - 2022-10-12

truehistory.us.title: War in the Modern World - From World War to Cold War
truehistory.us.description: The series of events that followed World War II from the allied occupation of Germany to the Greek Civil War; how the Soviet Union contended with insurgencies and the beginnings of conflict between the United States and the USSR. (History, World history) - 2022-10-12

truehistory.us.title: World War II: Up Close and Personal - Hitler and the Nazi Youth
truehistory.us.description: The horrors of Nazi Germany are one hallmark of World War II; pondering how ordinary German citizens find themselves participating in such heinous events; going inside the propaganda machine of Hitler's Germany; seeing how it targets the youth. (World history) - 2021-07-16

truehistory.us.title: World War II: Up Close and Personal - Japanese Soldiers in Nanjing
truehistory.us.description: The origins of World War II lie in Asia in 1931; tracing the invasion of 1937 and the Rape of Nanjing; witnessing the events through the eyes of a Chinese soldier and a Japanese journalist, young men who bear witness to the flesh and blood of battle. (World history) - 2021-07-16

truehistory.us.title: World War II: Up Close and Personal - Panzer Leaders Who Changed Warfare
truehistory.us.description: In addition to the story of people, World War II is the story of technology; perhaps nowhere is this more apparent than the tanks Germany uses to barrel across Poland and France in "lightning warfare"; how new technology defeats the old ways of war. (World history) - 2021-07-16

truehistory.us.title: World War II: Up Close and Personal - Jews Inside the Warsaw Ghetto
truehistory.us.description: Wartime Warsaw offers a gateway to the darkest events of the war; bearing witness as the city's Jews are rounded up and put in the ghetto, where the specter of disease and starvation always looms; stories from several of the ghetto's inhabitants. (World history) - 2021-07-16

truehistory.us.title: Masters of War: History's Greatest Strategic Thinkers - Why Strategy Matters
truehistory.us.description: If war is a gamble, then a strategy is key to success; a survey of why strategy is important; looking at World War II's "Operation Torch" as a case study for how the military should be used as an instrument of policy. (Educational, History) - 2012-09-28

truehistory.us.title: Masters of War: History's Greatest Strategic Thinkers - Thucydides On Strategy
truehistory.us.description: A systematic look at what makes Thucydides perhaps history's first great strategist; his analysis of the Peloponnesian War; the political origins of the war; the Spartan and Athenian leadership; the social and moral implications of war. (Educational, History) - 2012-09-28

truehistory.us.title: Masters of War: History's Greatest Strategic Thinkers - Thucydides as a Possession for All Time
truehistory.us.description: Joining a debate over the efficacy of the Sicilian Expedition; turning to the Melian Dialogue; the debate between realists and neoconservatives over the conduct of war; considering how this debate still plays out in contemporary America. (Educational, History) - 2012-09-28

truehistory.us.title: Masters of War: History's Greatest Strategic Thinkers - Sun Tzu's the Art of War
truehistory.us.description: Sun Tzu's writing is popular in the modern world; the historical context for "Master Sun's Military Methods"; an overview of Sun Tzu's strategy for war, which is to be efficient, avoid protracted wars and value the commander's intellect and skill. (Educational, History) - 2012-09-28

truehistory.us.title: Masters of War: History's Greatest Strategic Thinkers - Sun Tzu Through Time
truehistory.us.description: Charting Sun Tzu's historical importance throughout Chinese history, in feudal and modern Japan, and in the modern West; learning Sun Tzu's strategy of deception in action by exploring Operation Fortitude in the Allied invasion of Normandy. (Educational, History) - 2012-09-28

truehistory.us.title: Masters of War: History's Greatest Strategic Thinkers - Machiavelli's the Art of War
truehistory.us.description: Learning about Machiavelli, the Italian Renaissance man who writes his own "The Art of War" in which he advocates a citizen-army; going through Machiavelli's book of tactics, which is his recommendation for Florentine military rulers. (Educational, History) - 2012-09-28

truehistory.us.title: Masters of War: History's Greatest Strategic Thinkers - Machiavelli's Discourses On Livy
truehistory.us.description: Discovering fortuna, which is Machiavelli's philosophy of circumstances, and virtu, which is his recipe for military action; the strategies Machiavelli thinks a republican military should adopt; the qualities to look for in a good commander. (Educational, History) - 2012-09-28

truehistory.us.title: Masters of War: History's Greatest Strategic Thinkers - The Napoleonic Revolution in War
truehistory.us.description: Experiencing the battles of Jena and Auerstedt during the Napoleonic Wars; these two decisive victories demonstrate the radical transformation of warfare; they give rise to Antoine-Henri Jomini and Carl von Clausewitz, two important masters of war. (Educational, History) - 2012-09-28

truehistory.us.title: War in the Modern World - Afghanistan and the Nature of Modern War
truehistory.us.description: In the course's inaugural episode, begin to explore the transformation of violent conflicts between major world powers by delving into a particularly recent example: America's 20-year war in Afghanistan. (History, World history) - 2022-10-12

truehistory.us.title: War in the Modern World - Nightmare Scenarios of Modern War
truehistory.us.description: The factors that explain why wars between great powers look different nowadays, and explore what future conflicts could look like between the United States and two of its major adversaries. (History, World history) - 2022-10-12

truehistory.us.title: War in the Modern World - The Tools of Modern Warfare
truehistory.us.description: How five contemporary technologies-the Kalashnikov assault rifle, improvised explosive devices, guided missiles, drones, and cyber warfare-redefined the rules of battle and leveled the playing field between world powers and insurgent groups. (History, World history) - 2022-10-12

truehistory.us.title: War in the Modern World - From World War to Cold War
truehistory.us.description: The series of events that followed World War II from the allied occupation of Germany to the Greek Civil War; how the Soviet Union contended with insurgencies and the beginnings of conflict between the United States and the USSR. (History, World history) - 2022-10-12

truehistory.us.title: Great Board Games of the Ancient World - Bearing Off: The Story of Backgammon
truehistory.us.description: During the Third Crusade, the European soldiers spend the winter playing the ancient game of Tables, which would evolve into backgammon by the 20th century. (History) - 2022-07-15

truehistory.us.title: Great Board Games of the Ancient World - Senet: Egypt's Game of the Afterlife
truehistory.us.description: Unearthed artifacts from King Tutankhamun's tomb include Senet boards. Historians study the hieroglyphs and investigate the abrupt disappearance of this ancient Egyptian game. (History) - 2022-07-15

truehistory.us.title: Great Board Games of the Ancient World - Chess: The Evolution of a Strategy Icon
truehistory.us.description: Developed during the Guptas' rule in India, Chaturanga is a strategy game resembling chess. It gradually wended its way westward to become what it is in the present. (History) - 2022-07-15

truehistory.us.title: Great Board Games of the Ancient World - Chess's Eastern Cousins: Shogi and Xiangqi
truehistory.us.description: The East Asian games of Xiangqi and Shogi are potentially connected to Chaturanga and chess, but a lack of documentation makes it difficult to ascertain anything. (History) - 2022-07-15

truehistory.us.title: Great Board Games of the Ancient World - Go: A Game of Near-Infinite Complexity
truehistory.us.description: Go is an intricate strategy game that outshines chess in East Asia because of its challenging nature and unique setup. (History) - 2022-07-15

truehistory.us.title: Great Board Games of the Ancient World - Sowing Seeds: Africa's Mancala Family
truehistory.us.description: Mancala is a family of traditional African games dating back over 7,000 years. Awari and Bao are two members that fall on opposite ends of the spectrum of difficulty. (History) - 2022-07-15

truehistory.us.title: Decoding the Secrets of Egyptian Hieroglyphs - Why Egypt Needed Hieroglyphs
truehistory.us.description: Understanding why Ancient Egypt has to invent some form of writing; central to this introduction is a study of the Narmer Palette; its writing sets standards and conventions that would be followed for 3,000 years. (World history) - 2016-10-21

truehistory.us.title: Decoding the Secrets of Egyptian Hieroglyphs - The Ancient Egyptian Alphabet
truehistory.us.description: Learning the hieroglyphic alphabet; how to write and position each hieroglyph, including a stylized hand, a horned viper and two hieroglyphs for which English does not have a letter; transcribing one's name from English to ancient Egyptian. (World history) - 2016-10-21

truehistory.us.title: Decoding the Secrets of Egyptian Hieroglyphs - How a Language Becomes Lost
truehistory.us.description: Wondering how it is possible for a language used by the world's greatest civilization to become lost; charting the rise and fall of Ancient Egypt's kingdoms; investigating the ways Christianity replaces hieroglyphs with Greek letters. (World history) - 2016-10-21

truehistory.us.title: Decoding the Secrets of Egyptian Hieroglyphs - Napoleon in Egypt
truehistory.us.description: Exploring how hieroglyphs and the ability to read them are rediscovered during Napoleon's invasion of Egypt; considering the birth of Egyptology; the role of ushabtis, statues of servants that are buried with prominent Egyptians. (World history) - 2016-10-21

truehistory.us.title: World Heritage Sites: Exploring the World's Greatest Places - Paleolithic Cave Art of Spain and France
truehistory.us.description: The oldest paintings in the world, in the extraordinary cave art of Altamira, Lascaux, and Chauvet. (Travel) - 2022-06-06

truehistory.us.title: World Heritage Sites: Exploring the World's Greatest Places - The Taj Mahal of Agra
truehistory.us.description: Learning about the builder of Taj, the Mughal emperor Shah Jahan, and his beloved wife Mumtaz Mahal, for whom it was built. (Travel) - 2022-06-06

truehistory.us.title: World Heritage Sites: Exploring the World's Greatest Places - Australia's Great Barrier Reef
truehistory.us.description: The Great Barrier Reef is one of the world's natural wonders, drawing travelers to its shimmering, multicolored coral reefs, teeming with fascinating marine life.

truehistory.us.title: World Heritage Sites: Exploring the World's Greatest Places - The Mogao Grottoes and Manuscripts
truehistory.us.description: The Mogao Grottoes, dug out of cliffs in the desert of northwestern China, contain one of the most dazzling collections of Buddhist art in the world.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Street Food Asia - Bangkok's Night Market
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke continues his street food journey in Bangkok where he searches for the best Tom Yum soup and entertains the locals with a rare Thai delicacy. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Street Food Asia - Malaysian Flying Noodles and Pork Bone Soup
tastemadetravel.us.description: In Kuala Lumpur, Luke meets the famous Mr Hung with a reputation for flying instant noodles and Mr Sou who cooks a hearty Pork Bone Soup with medicinal herbal properties. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's India - Hunting for Ancient Spices in Thekkady
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke visits the lush plantations of spices in Thekkady and then tours Madurai, the spiritual heart of Tamil Nadu, to find hidden gems with the help of a local food journalist. (Cooking, Travel) - 2023-12-05

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's India - The Outrageous Street Food of Pondicherry
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke uncovers the history of Chettinad and savours its famous cuisine. He then tastes the chutneys in Kumbakonam and explores the exciting food scene in Pondicherry. (Cooking, Travel) - 2023-12-12

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's India - Celebrating Diwali in Chennai
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke visits Chennai, the capital of Tamil Nadu, a bustling city with historic ancient temples, and a vibrant modern art scene. (Cooking, Travel) - 2023-12-19

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's India - Exploring the Night Markets of Bangalore
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke heads to the city of Bangalore in southern India; he visits MTR, one of the oldest coffee houses in the city; he learns how to make idli; he meets up with a friend to explore the night markets. (Cooking, Travel) - 2023-11-21

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Guayabera World
tastemadetravel.us.description: In Tekit, the capital of the Guayabera, Pati encounters a tale of sons going against their father's wishes to follow their own path. Pati meets a farmer's son who went against his father to build a family business making the iconic Guayabera shirts. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Los Mariachis
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati learns about the history, the instruments, and the meaning behind Mariachi music. Pati makes carne en su jugo, tres chiles guacamole, and masa berry shortcake. (Cooking) - 2024-03-07

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - The Heart of Tequila
tastemadetravel.us.description: Exploring the town of Tequila, Jalisco; the history of making tequila and a close up look at the process from the agave fields to the tasting table. (Cooking) - 2021-11-03

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Sisters, Stew, and Sass
tastemadetravel.us.description: Roasted tomatoes rice with cumin and oregano; chicken livers with chipotle caramelized onions; avocado and panela cheese salad. (Cooking) - 2022-09-16

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Traditional Greek Cuisine
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie heads to Greece, to the island of Skopelos, starting on the mainland in Thessaloniki. Inspired by meze plates and traditional island cuisine he cooks up a smoky aubergine flatbread and a lemony chargrilled chicken with tzatziki and rice. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Making Couscous in Tunisia
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie explores Tunisia to meet traditional couscous makers, eat delicious street food, and get invited to cook with local chefs on a beach. Inspired by everything he sees, Jamie cooks crispy prawn parcels and a chicken and merguez sausage stew. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Inspirational Spanish Tapas
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie's soaking up inspiration in Spain with tapas, flavor-charged rice dishes, and spectacular seafood. He cooks a stunning pork chop with peppers and aioli and a surf and turf skewer of prawns, mushrooms, and local ham. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Stunning Seafood of Marseille
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie heads to Marseille in the south of France. Inspired by their stunning seafood, the traditional flavors of Provence, and the multicultural dishes being served up there, he cooks up a steak with a twist and a sublime courgette and olive tart. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Worth the Hype - Picasso Pasta, Custard Cups & Cowboy Steaks in New Jersey
tastemadetravel.us.description: Grab your fork and join Frankie Celenza as he eats his way through New Jersey's most iconic spots that are worth the hype. From silky custard cups to pasta Picasso to giant pizza slices, just add PEPSI and you've got the perfect pairing. (Cooking, Entertainment)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Worth the Hype - Smothered Pork Chops, Ramen & Fried Flounder in Charleston
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pull up a seat and join Frankie Celenza as he eats his way through Charleston, South Carolina's most iconic spots that are worth the hype. From coastal soul to Lowcountry classics, just add PEPSI and you've got the perfect pairing. (Cooking, Entertainment)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Worth the Hype - Chicken Fried Steak, BBQ & Biscuits in San Antonio
tastemadetravel.us.description: Ready for Texas-sized flavors? Join Frankie Celenza as he eats his way through San Antonio's most iconic spots that are worth the hype. From authentic Tex-Mex to Hill Country BBQ, just add PEPSI and you've got the perfect pairing. (Cooking, Entertainment)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Worth the Hype - Fish Tacos, Bacon Burgers & Bucatini in San Francisco
tastemadetravel.us.description: Let's dig in. Join Frankie Celenza as he eats his way through San Francisco's most iconic spots that are worth the hype. From classic diner bites to fusion feasts to waterfront fish tacos, just add PEPSI and you've got the perfect pairing. (Cooking, Entertainment)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Tasty Ant Eggs in Ninh Binh
tastemadetravel.us.description: After a long trip from Hue, Luke finally gets some rest in the scenic Ninh Bihn. Tag along as Luke meets with a local rice farmer, takes a canoe out for some crab hunting, and ventures deep into the jungle in search of a local delicacy- red ant eggs! (Cooking, Travel) - 2020-03-24

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Searching For The Banh Da Noodle in Hai Phong
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke is in northern Vietnam- Hai Phong! This is the birthplace of his partner Lynne. Join Luke as he meets some of Lynne's family for the first time, and tries the delicious Banh Da Noodle- a tasty dish that Hai Phong is renowned for! (Cooking, Travel) - 2020-03-31

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Delicious Bun Cha in Hanoi
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke's penultimate stop on his train journey is Hanoi. Follow Luke on his hunt for an iconic Hanoi dish, Bun Cha. Luke takes a ride on the Reunification Express railway, and visits the famous Hoan Kiem Lake for some delicious magenta sticky rice. (Cooking, Travel) - 2020-04-07

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Yucatán Meats
tastemadetravel.us.description: Temozón is the birthplace of Yucatán's signature smoked meat Carne Ahumada and everyone in town claims to have a relative who invented it. Pati strolls around town to try different versions of Carne Ahumada. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - A Mayan League of Their Own
tastemadetravel.us.description: Amazonas softball team; sweet potato and meat salpicon; pepita, egg and chaya tamales; roasted tomato and habanero salsa. (Cooking) - 2023-11-17

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Tucson: Gateway to Sonora
tastemadetravel.us.description: In Tucson, Pati learns the basics of artisan bread-making from Don Guerra of Barrio Bakery. She crosses into Sonora, Mexico, to see where the wheat is from. Back in her kitchen, Pati creates a menu of tasty recipes using wheat flour. (Cooking) - 2024-01-25

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Jalisco Classics
tastemadetravel.us.description: In Guadalajara, Pati learns the secrets to menudo and birria. In her kitchen, Pati perfects her own recipes for a few Jalisco favorites: menudo, tepache, and jericalla. (Cooking) - 2024-03-07

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Hermosillo Food Crawl
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati spends a day in Sonora's capital, Hermosillo, visiting some of the city's best culinary destinations. From gigantic burritos at Doña Guille to Sonoran hot dogs, Pati experiences all Hermosillo's food scene has to offer.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - The Blessing and The Benefit
tastemadetravel.us.description: On the coast in Bahía Kino, local fishermen catch giant sea scallops. Then, in the mountain town of Matape, Nere, one of Sonora's few female butchers shares her wisdom with Pati.

thechallenge.us.description: S29 E07 Achy Breaky Heart Jenna wants to rekindle her relationship with her ex, but a rumor gets in the way; the Champions vow to even out the bank accounts.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge: Champs vs. Pros
thechallenge.us.description: S01 E01 Secrets and Limes Host and NFL star Victor Cruz introduces 10 champs to their newest competition: a collection of 10 world-class professional athletes.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge: Champs vs. Pros
thechallenge.us.description: S01 E02 Settling the Scores The rivalry between Wes and Bananas comes to the forefront; a pick-up game of football, led by NFL stars Shawne Merriman and Kamerion Wimbley, escalates into off-field drama for Lolo Jones and Lindsey Jacobellis.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge: Champs vs. Pros
thechallenge.us.description: S01 E03 Watch Out for the Wolfpack The players get to choose their own match ups when the Champs go one-on-one with the Pros; a shocking proposal puts one Pro in a real bind.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge: Champs vs. Pros
thechallenge.us.description: S01 E04 A Cold Day in Hell A Pro turns to a Champ for advice as the politics of the game intensifies; a tricky challenge turns testy when both teams try to get an edge by engaging in dirty tricks.

classica.us.title: Im Atelier des Künstlers
classica.us.description: In dieser Serie spielt der Pianist Philippe Cassard in einer Meisterklasse Werke von Claude Debussy. (Event, Music, Classical) - 2021-07-07

classica.us.title: Schumann - Faschingsschwank aus Wien, op. 26
classica.us.description: Die Sendung zeigt eine Aufführung von Schumanns "Faschingsschwank aus Wien, op. 26". (Special, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2023-12-12

classica.us.title: Mahler - 4. Sinfonie
classica.us.description: Kirill Karabits dirigiert Gustav Mahlers 4. Sinfonie. Als Solistin tritt die Sopranistin Lucy Crowe auf. Seine Vierte Sinfonie beginnt mit Schellenklang, Vogelgezwitscher und einer Melodie, wie direkt aus Mozarts Welt. Alles wirkt wunderbar einfach. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2025-12-20

classica.us.title: Misha Enzovoort
classica.us.description: Für Misha Mengelberg hat das Vergessen begonnen. Er wartet auf ein Taxi, das er nicht gerufen hat, um zu einem Konzert zu fahren, das nicht stattfindet. Der niederländische Komponist, Pianist und Meister des Jazz Misha Mengelberg, geboren 1935, taucht immer tiefer in das Dunkel der Demenz, die sein Musikerleben beendet. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2017-05-19

classica.us.title: Schumann - Sinfonie Nr. 1 in B-Dur
classica.us.description: Der deutsche Dirigent Christian Zacharias leitet das Orchestre national de Lille bei einer Aufführung von Schumanns Sinfonie Nr. 1 in B-Dur, Op. 38. Das Konzert wurde am 16. Juni 2017 im Auditorium du Nouveau Siècle in Lille aufgezeichnet. (Special, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2025-05-03

classica.us.title: Schostakowitsch - Präludien und Fugen
classica.us.description: Beim 58. Stresa Festival bringt die Compagnia Simona Bucci „Preludi e Fughe: Geografia antropica" auf die Bühne des Teatro Il Maggiore in Verbania. Sieben Tänzer interpretieren ausgewählte Präludien und Fugen op. 87 von Dmitri Schostakowitsch, die ein Pianist live spielt. Choreografin Simona Bucci verbindet Musik und Bewegung zu einer eindrucksvollen Bildsprache. Die Aufführung entsteht im August 2019 und vereint Konzert und Tanz zu einem intensiven Bühnenerlebnis. (Special, Performing arts, Music, Concert) - 2021-08-01

classica.us.title: Mozart - 35. Sinfonie
classica.us.description: Der bekannte Dirigent Conrad van Alphen dirigiert die Sinfonia Rotterdam in einer gelungenen Aufführung von Mozarts Sinfonie Nummer 35 D-Dur KV 385. Diese wurde im Jahr 2020 in der Nieuwe Kerk in Den Haag in den Niederlanden aufgenommen. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2021-06-28

classica.us.title: Cartoons in Concert
classica.us.description: Beliebte Figuren aus der Welt der Cartoons und Animationsfilme treffen im Konzertsaal auf eine mitreißende musikalische Fusion. Gemeinsam mit Chören und Orchestern des DR entsteht ein einzigartiges Konzerterlebnis. Seien Sie gespannt! (Special, Music, Concert) - 2024-12-24

classica.us.title: Le Grand Orgue in Concert
classica.us.description: Olivier Latry, der Titularorganist der großen Orgel der Pariser Kathedrale Notre-Dame, verzaubert mit einer meisterhaften Performance an der historischen Orgel der Kathedrale. Das Konzert entstand 2015 unter der Regie von Noëlle Louisor. (Special, Music, Documentary) - 2019-05-07

classica.us.title: Mahler - Sinfonie Nr. 2, 'Auferstehung'
classica.us.description: Orchester und Chor des Maggio Musicale Fiorentino unter der Leitung von Myung-Whun Chung spielen Mahlers Auferstehungssymphonie. Solistinnen sind Christiane Karg, Sopran, und Claudia Huckle, Alt. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2024-08-16

classica.us.title: Werke von Bach, Bartók und Brahms
classica.us.description: Iván Fischer führt sein Budapest Festival Orchester mit Werken von Johann Sebastian Bach, Béla Bartók und Johannes Brahms. Die Aufführung wurde am 4. Dezember 2017 in der Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest aufgezeichnet. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2018-06-09

classica.us.title: Franck - Sonate für Violine und Klavier
classica.us.description: Martha Argerich und Maxim Vengerov spielen César Francks Sonate für Violine und Klavier in A-Dur. Anlässlich ihres 80. Geburtstags widmete sich die argentinische Pianistin bei diesem Konzert im Château de Chantilly der Kammermusik. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2025-06-07

classica.us.title: Beethoven - 3. Sinfonie in Es-Dur, op. 55
classica.us.description: Der Dirigent Fabio Luisi leitet das Dänische Radio-Sinfonieorchester in einer Aufführung von Beethovens 3. Sinfonie in Es-Dur, Op. 55. Neben der fantastischen "Eroica" werden auch Strawinskis Psalmensinfonie und Strauss' "Don Juan" interpretiert. (Special, Entertainment, Music, Concert) - 2020-12-10

classica.us.title: Mahler - Das Lied von der Erde
classica.us.description: Die Mezzosopranistin Magdalena Kožená und der Tenor Andrew Staples schließen sich Sir Simon Rattle an, um den Zyklus "Das Lied von der Erde" von Gustav Mahler zu Gehör zu bringen. Das Konzert fand am 9. Mai 2021 im Barbican Centre in London statt. (Special, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2025-12-06

classica.us.title: Martha Argerich - Eine Geburtstagsfeier - II
classica.us.description: Anlässlich ihres 80. Geburtstags erkundet die argentinische Pianistin Martha Argerich im Château de Chantilly das Repertoire der Kammermusik. Die "Grande Dame" des Klaviers wird von verschiedenen renommierten Künstlern begleitet. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2024-08-24

classica.us.title: Mozart - 23. Klavierkonzerte, KV 488
classica.us.description: Francesco Attesti gilt als einer der besten Interpreten des romantischen Repertoires. Zusammen mit dem Dirigenten Paolo Belloli und dem OIDA-Orchester spielt er die Klavierkonzerte Nr. 14 und 23, KV 449 und KV 488 von Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert, Event) - 2020-12-03

classica.us.title: Beethoven, Klavierkonzert Nr. 3 c-Moll op. 37
classica.us.description: Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827): Klavierkonzert Nr. 3 c-Moll op. 37. Yefim Bronfman (Klavier), Staatskapelle Dresden, Leitung: Christian Thielemann. Aufgenommen in der Semperoper Dresden. Beethovens Ausdrucksmittel für Sturm und Drang war c-Moll: In dieser Tonart schrieb er seine dramatischsten und heroischsten Werke, darunter die 5. Symphonie und die Klaviersonate op. 13, seine berühmte "Pathétique". (Special, Entertainment, Music, Classical) - 2017-03-27

classica.us.title: Werke für Cello und Klavier: Debussy, Brahms u.a
classica.us.description: Silvia Chiesa und Maurizio Baglini präsentieren ein Konzert im Rahmen des Amiata Piano Festivals 2023, das im Forum Fondazione Bertarelli in Poggi del Sasso in Italien gegeben wurde. Es wurden Stücke von Claude Debussy und Johannes Brahms gespielt. (Special, Music, Event) - 2025-01-06

classica.us.title: In der Probe: - Esa-Pekka Salonen
classica.us.description: Esa-Pekka Salonen probt mit dem Los Angeles Philharmoniker Claude Debussys Orchesterwerk "La mer". Probeaufnahmen wie diese liefern einen spannenden Einblick in Salonens akribische Arbeit und sein Verhältnis zu den Musikern und der Musik. (Music) - 2008-04-16

spectrumoc16.us.title: Da Braddahs & Friends

spectrumoc16.us.title: The Joy of Crafting
spectrumoc16.us.description: Rendall Madarang makes a pumpkin from chenille stems; Leona Ahlo and Brandon Tavares share new DIY aquarium projects; Brandon creates maple leaves from chenille stems and adds them to chenille pumpkins for a beautiful fall garland. (Art, Arts/crafts, How-to) - 2026-10-18

spectrumoc16.us.title: Elevate 808
spectrumoc16.us.description: See how Able Pest Management helps with feral chickens and Coconut Rhinoceros Beetles. The Bounty Project is getting abandoned fishing gear out of the ocean. Find out how Hungry Ear Records, Hawaii's oldest record store, has stayed open for so long. (Community) - 2026-07-29

spectrumoc16.us.title: Cooking Hawaiian Style
spectrumoc16.us.description: Da Bald Guy Food Truck, a North Shore favorite, is known for generous portions, bold local flavors, and Aloha Spirit. Serving pan-fried poke, garlic shrimp, braised kalbi, and comfort food, it's a must-visit spot for kama'aina and visitors alike. (Cooking) - 2026-10-26

spectrumoc16.us.title: Showcase Hawaii
spectrumoc16.us.description: Two island favorites come together in the beautiful Plumeria Wai Koa Drop Earrings. Warm koa wood inlay, delicate plumeria accents and a polished gold-plated finish create an elegant tropical look. Approximately a 1 1/2-inch drop. (Entertainment, Shopping, Community) - 2026-10-02

spectrumoc16.us.title: The Champ Show
spectrumoc16.us.description: Join Champ as he visits local establishments and shows you the products and services they offer, including tasting the cuisine of Hawaii's eateries. (Talk) - 2023-06-03

spectrumoc16.us.title: Ocean Paddler TV

spectrumoc16.us.title: Painting in Paradise
spectrumoc16.us.description: Join the "Paint like Bob Ross…Island Style" workshop with Corinna Repucci. Meet artist Thomas Dier for artistic insights, and watch Patrick Ching create a ceramic and glass mural at Lehua Elementary School. (Art, Entertainment) - 2026-09-23

spectrumoc16.us.title: Fashion Sense by Valerie
